text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Eishin Flash's second summer camp, her last and biggest chance to gear up for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The impending end to this journey weighs heavily on me, and I vow to commit the sight of Eishin Flash running to my memory.
